card.title: Become What You Compete With
card.instruction: Turn comparison into imitation: adopt whatever quality seems powerful, allowing each borrowed trait to change the basis of the rivalry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your cake won because it was minimalist. I'm removing half my decorations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I won for giving everyone a slice. Yours stayed behind glass.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll serve pieces twice your size. Pass me the knife.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's a queue of twenty. I cut mine small so nobody missed out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then mine will be thinner. I'll feed the queue and the people they go home to.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 imitates apparent minimalism, A3 adopts generosity as larger slices and A5 copies small portions to exceed B's reach.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 actual sharing basis changes A3 tactic; B4 queue rationale changes A5 portion size and audience.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 correct the reason for success through specific serving choices.

heightening.evidence: B4 explanation reverses A5 slice size while preserving the desire to outperform the newly understood trait.

specificity.evidence: A1 cake comparison and B2 glass display establish a concrete rivalry in serving and reception.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 feeding people the queue goes home to heightens B4 inclusiveness rather than adding unrelated wit.
